# Sagar Pathak — Developer Portfolio

Sagar Pathak is a web developer and final-year BSc Information Technology student based in
Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India. He builds web projects, interactive experiments and 3D
simulations with React, JavaScript and TypeScript, and is open to remote work across India.

## Site

- [Homepage — Sagar Pathak | Web Developer & React Developer in Rishikesh](https://sagar-horizon.vercel.app/): main portfolio page.
- [Sitemap](https://sagar-horizon.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for the site.
- [Robots.txt](https://sagar-horizon.vercel.app/robots.txt): crawler rules and sitemap pointer.
- [Open Graph / social preview image](https://sagar-horizon.vercel.app/og-image.png): 1200x630 preview image.

## Projects (LIVE / PROTOTYPE)

- [SPDC Quiz Battle — real-time quiz platform](https://spdcquiz.vercel.app/): React + TypeScript + Upstash Redis real-time quiz. Source: https://github.com/Sagar264offici/QuizBattle
- [Rishikesh Greens Cafe — restaurant website concept](https://rishikesh-greens-cafe.vercel.app/): responsive cafe site. Source: https://github.com/Sagar264offici/01_Restraunt_Web_Project
- [Daitya Legion — cricket team landing page](https://daitya-legion.vercel.app/): team branding landing page. Source: https://github.com/Sagar264offici/Daitya_Legion_Landing_Page
- [Dentist Clinic Prototype — clinic website prototype](https://dentist-clinic-prototype.vercel.app/): service/appointment prototype. Source: https://github.com/Sagar264offici/dentist-clinic-prototype
- [Cricket Field Simulation — 3D cricket field](https://cricket-field-simulation.vercel.app/): Three.js 3D cricket field with controllable camera. Source: https://github.com/Sagar264offici/Cricket_Field_Simulation
- [NightLight — immersive music experience](https://nightlight-music.vercel.app/): mood-aware music player.
- [Sagar Web Package — website development packages](https://sagar-web-package.vercel.app/): five fixed-scope web development packages with comparison table and quote flow.
